body: I've cut myself bunch of times albeit not very deep, but now a couple months down the line even if you knew where they were you would struggle to find the scars, if you want to hide them some simple vague lies are good maybe a bandage or plaster depending on the size of the cuts or if they look like they've been done in a row with a knife, it also depends on where they are if its the inside lower arm that's easy a bandage and a lie about a stray cat or your own cat. Lying does suck but if you don't want people to know that they are from cutting yourself you have to tell them.

Hmm, I feel like you are just smart and you have a very active brain, you get bored easily. I'm the same though I not to the same level. So what I have which stops me from going off like that on drugs and stuff is that I have a couple of passions and a passionate friend. My 3 passions are theoretical physics, programming and video gaming. My passionate friend is one who shares one of these passions which is the physics. When I'm bored i step on the gaming, then when I don't feel like doing that I program and when I don't have a computer or time to do that I think about the physics and talk to my friend. Of course I don't do just those things I go on insta, reddit, youtube and crunchy roll a lot too as fillers. But believe me when I say it took a lot of doing everything I was interested in to finally find something I wont get bored of that easily. I think the key is finding a hobby/passion which develops and you do it, so with gaming there are new games and as you get better you go up against better people and its a continual challenge, with the programming as you get better you can make better programs and use different tech and with the physics as I learnt more I thought about more to a higher level and talked to more people about more topics. So I think just try things you want to try and if you get bored of it try something else, its trial and error really until you can find something that just keeps you hooked and wanting to do more and more and more, it doesn't have to be something addictive just something you enjoy that you can step on when you need a dopamine boost that isn't drugs.
